verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents local evaluation in server SDKs and on-device client SDKs, plus an HTTP API. Nothing mentions edge or CDN-worker SDKs, edge-config integrations, or a relay/proxy layer that evaluates flags close to users. Generic local SDK evaluation is an adjacent capability, not the edge-delivery capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can evaluate flags at the edge (CDN workers or an edge/relay layer) close to users
